1 حَدَقَهُ (K, TA) بِعَيْنِهِ, aor.
حَدِقَ , inf. n. حَدْقٌ, (TA,) He looked at it. (K, TA.) It is said in a trad., فَحَدَقَنِى القَوْمُ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ And the people, or party, cast the blacks of their eyes at me. (TA.) And حَدَقَهُ He, or it, hit, or hurt, the black of his eye. (K.) ＝
-A2- حَدَقَ, (K, TA,) aor.
حَدِقَ , (TA,) inf. n. حُدُوقٌ, said of one that is dying (مَيِّت), He opened his eyes, and moved his eyelids, or twinkled with his eyes. (K.) You say, رَأَيْتُ المَيِّتَ يَحْدِقُ I saw him that was dying open his eyes, &c. (TA.) ＝
-A3- See also 4.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
